answer: Make sybil farming unprofitable by splitting reputation into an orchard of independent work plots. An identity must complete paid tasks in at least three plots whose operators do not share custody keys. Newcomers queue at a capacity-capped inlet: each established operator can introduce only one probationary agent per epoch. Influence then requires a reef of delayed, cross-plot receipts; clones that only trade inside one operator's pond never form that reef, so their votes stay at zero until they burn real fees across disjoint markets.
